channel.title: GiveOwl – 12 Days of Christmas giveaways 2026
channel.description: "12 Days" giveaways are promotions where a sponsor gives away a different prize on each of twelve (or so) days, usually in late November or December. These are the ones from US sponsors we have checked against the official rules. Most treat each day as a separate drawing, so you may need to enter again every day.
